units.source_text: 后山里有一处布满藻类的寂静的池沼，人称安民泽。

en.t: In the hills behind the temple there was a quiet pond covered with algae, known as Anmintaku.

units.source_text: 池中有一小岛，耸立着一座名叫白蛇冢的五重石堆。

en.t: In the pond there was a small island, and on it stood a five-tiered pile of stones called the White Snake Mound.

units.source_text: 这一带的早晨，鸟儿啁啾鸣啭，却看不见鸟影，仿佛整片林子都充满了婉转的鸟语。

en.t: In the mornings around here, birds chirped and sang, yet not a single bird could be seen, as though the whole grove were filled with their sweet, warbling voices.
